chose: A tap's send or Unpair stops a running drain and goes first; the stopped run keeps what home took and asks again once the link frees.
options: the send or Unpair stops the drain
the send or Unpair waits for the drain to end
gray: Waiting is simpler but holds a tap for as long as the paced backlog takes (about 90 s for 94 items, 45 of them after the burst); stopping means a run ends part-way and must resume.
undo: Make a send and Unpair wait on the drain side in model.ts instead of stopping it.
